    Proposition 2.10(1): evaluation is an equivalence add C ≃ mod A₀ #

    prop:projective-evaluation(1) (graded-category.tex): "Evaluation induces an equivalence add C ≃ mod A₀."

    add C is the category of finite families of labels with matrices of morphisms (AddC), and mod A₀ the full subcategory of finitely generated modules over the category algebra of the projective labels (ModFG). Evaluation is a functor (evFunctor); it is faithful (evMap_injective), full (evMap_surjective) and essentially surjective (InjData.essSurj), hence an equivalence (evFunctor_isEquivalence).
